# SQL Patterns: traffic.sellercenter_dwd_click_di__reg_live

*Auto-generated by ads-kb-datamap (from-code) — 13 references (0 write, 13 read)*
*Generated on: 2026-06-16*

## Common WHERE Filters

### Partition & Time Filters

```sql
-- 昨日数据（最常用，~70%）
WHERE grass_date = date_add('day', -1, current_date)

-- 参数化日期范围（workflow 中使用）
WHERE grass_date <= DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_date >= date_sub(DATE('${grass_date}'), 1)

-- 固定日期范围
WHERE grass_date BETWEEN DATE('2025-10-01') AND DATE('2025-10-31')
```

### tz_type Filter (Always 'local')

```sql
AND tz_type = 'local'
```

### grass_region Filter

```sql
-- 标准 8 区 + OTHER（侧边栏分析常用）
AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN', 'OTHER')

-- 参数化单区域（workflow 中使用）
AND grass_region = UPPER('${region}')

-- 全 8 区（包含 BR）
AND grass_region IN ('TH', 'PH', 'TW', 'SG', 'BR', 'ID', 'MY', 'VN')
```

### Time Range Filter (event_timestamp-based)

```sql
-- 限制点击事件发生在同一天内
AND date_format(
    from_unixtime(event_timestamp / 1000), '%Y-%m-%d'
) = date_format(date_add('day', -1, current_date), '%Y-%m-%d')
```

### Page Type & Section Filters

```sql
-- 侧边导航栏点击
AND page_type = 'seller_center_sidebar'
AND page_section[1] = 'left_navigation'

-- Shopee Ads 主页点击
AND page_type = 'seller_center_shopee_ads'
AND page_section[1] = 'rapid_boost_banner'
```

### target_type Filter

```sql
-- 仅广告入口点击
AND target_type = 'paid_ads'

-- Rapid Boost 按钮
AND target_type = 'activate_now'
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

### JOIN dim_shop 补全 shop_id

最常用的 JOIN 模式：通过 user_id 关联维表获取 shop_id（当点击表中 shop_id 为空时）：

```sql
LEFT JOIN mp_user.dim_shop__reg_s0_live b
    ON a.user_id = b.user_id
-- 再通过 COALESCE(a.shop_id, b.shop_id) 补全
```

### JOIN 埋点映射表（入口归因）

```sql
LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.dim_campaign_entrance_mapping__reg_s0_live b
    ON CONCAT_WS('-', a.page_type, a.page_section[1], a.target_type) = b.tracking_feature
```

### JOIN Campaign 维表

```sql
JOIN mp_paidads.dim_campaign__reg_s0_live b
    ON a.campaign_id = b.campaign_id
WHERE b.grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND b.tz_type = 'local'
```

### UNION ALL with shopee_traffic_dwd_click_hi

跨表合并点击数据（Campaign 入口归因场景）：

```sql
SELECT ..., CONCAT_WS('-', page_type, page_section[0], target_type) AS click_feature_detail
FROM traffic.sellercenter_dwd_click_di__reg_live
WHERE grass_region = UPPER('${region}')
  AND grass_date <= DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_date >= date_sub(DATE('${grass_date}'), 1)
  AND tz_type = 'local'
UNION ALL
SELECT ..., CONCAT_WS('-', page_type, page_section[0], target_type) AS click_feature_detail
FROM traffic.shopee_traffic_dwd_click_hi__reg_s1_live
WHERE grass_region = UPPER('${region}')
  AND local_date <= DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND local_date >= date_sub(DATE('${grass_date}'), 1)
```

注意：union 时字段名差异 — sellercenter 用 `user_id`，shopee_traffic 用 `userid`。

## Common Aggregations

### Click-to-View Gap 分析聚合

```sql
SELECT
    target_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT shop_id) AS shop_cnt,
    SUM(view_after_1clk_in_3s) AS view_after_1clk_in_3s_shop_cnt,
    SUM(view_after_1clk_in_5s) AS view_after_1clk_in_5s_shop_cnt,
    SUM(view_after_1clk_in_10s) AS view_after_1clk_in_10s_shop_cnt,
    SUM(view_after_1clk_in_30s) AS view_after_1clk_in_30s_shop_cnt,
    SUM(view_after_1clk_in_3s) * 100.00 / COUNT(shop_id) AS pct_in_3s_shop_cnt
FROM navi_leadpage_clk_view_gap
GROUP BY target_type
```

### First-Click Selection (窗口函数)

```sql
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT *,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY target_type, shop_id
            ORDER BY clk_event_timestamp ASC
        ) AS rank
    FROM navi_bar_shop_clk
)
WHERE rank = 1
```

### 独立点击事件计数

```sql
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN target_type = 'activate_now' THEN event_id END) AS pv,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN target_type = 'activate_now' THEN shop_id END) AS uv
FROM traffic.sellercenter_dwd_click_di__reg_live
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: 侧边导航栏点击提取 (summary_total)

```sql
SELECT
    shop_id, user_id, grass_region,
    CAST(json_extract_scalar(data, '$.click_timestamp') AS BIGINT) AS clk_event_timestamp,
    CASE WHEN target_type = 'paid_ads' THEN 'Marketing Centre/Shopee Ads'
         ELSE 'others' END AS target_type
FROM traffic.sellercenter_dwd_click_di__reg_live
WHERE grass_date = date_add('day', -1, current_date)
  AND page_type = 'seller_center_sidebar'
  AND page_section[1] = 'left_navigation'
  AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN', 'OTHER')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND date_format(from_unixtime(
      CAST(json_extract_scalar(data, '$.click_timestamp') AS BIGINT) / 1000
  ), '%Y-%m-%d') = date_format(date_add('day', -1, current_date), '%Y-%m-%d')
```

### Snippet 2: Campaign 入口归因点击提取 (campaign_entrance)

```sql
SELECT
    shop_id, user_id,
    event_id AS click_event_id,
    event_timestamp AS click_event_timestamp,
    from_unixtime(event_timestamp / 1000) AS click_event_datetime,
    CONCAT_WS('-', page_type, page_section[1], target_type) AS click_feature_detail,
    CAST(json_extract_scalar(data, '$.boost_status') AS INT) AS boost_status,
    CAST(json_extract_scalar(data, '$.boost_type') AS INT) AS boost_type,
    json_extract_scalar(data, '$.card_type') AS card_type,
    json_extract_scalar(data, '$.button_action') AS button_action
FROM traffic.sellercenter_dwd_click_di__reg_live
WHERE grass_region = UPPER('${region}')
  AND grass_date <= DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_date >= date_sub(DATE('${grass_date}'), 1)
  AND tz_type = 'local'
```

### Snippet 3: Rapid Boost Banner Click (robin_li/rapid_boost)

```sql
SELECT
    'b.clk',
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN target_type = 'activate_now' THEN event_id END) AS pv,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN target_type = 'activate_now' THEN shop_id END) AS uv
FROM traffic.sellercenter_dwd_click_di__reg_live
WHERE grass_region IN ('TH', 'PH', 'TW', 'SG', 'BR', 'ID', 'MY', 'VN')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND grass_date BETWEEN DATE('2025-10-01') AND DATE('2025-10-31')
  AND page_type = 'seller_center_shopee_ads'
  AND page_section[1] = 'rapid_boost_banner'
```

### Snippet 5: Spark SQL with get_json_object (summary_total_spark)

```sql
SELECT
    shop_id, user_id, grass_region,
    CAST(get_json_object(data, '$.click_timestamp') AS BIGINT) AS clk_event_timestamp,
    CASE WHEN target_type = 'paid_ads' THEN 'Marketing Centre/Shopee Ads'
         ELSE 'others' END AS target_type
FROM traffic.sellercenter_dwd_click_di__reg_live
WHERE grass_date = date_add(current_date(), -1)
  AND page_type = 'seller_center_sidebar'
  AND page_section[0] = 'left_navigation'
  AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN', 'OTHER')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND date_format(from_unixtime(
      CAST(get_json_object(data, '$.click_timestamp') AS BIGINT) / 1000
  ), 'yyyy-MM-dd') = date_format(date_add(current_date(), -1), 'yyyy-MM-dd')
```
